title: Microsoft, Google and xAI agree to pre-release US government security testing
summary: NIST's Center for AI Standards and Innovation will get early access to frontier models from Microsoft, Google DeepMind and xAI for national-security testing, joining OpenAI and Anthropic.
reason: Expands third-party (government) pre-deployment eval regime to most US frontier labs.

title: Coinbase cuts ~700 jobs (14%) to rebuild around AI
summary: Coinbase announced about 700 layoffs as CEO Brian Armstrong restructured the company around AI agents and consolidated roles.

title: PayPal to cut ~20% of staff over 2-3 years in AI-driven turnaround
summary: WSJ reported PayPal plans to cut roughly 4,760 jobs; executives said on the earnings call they will aggressively adopt AI and automation for $1.5B savings.
reason: Large planned cut tied to AI, multi-year and not fully confirmed.

title: Major publishers file class action against Meta over AI training on pirated books
summary: Elsevier, Hachette, McGraw Hill and others sued Meta alleging Llama was trained on pirated copyrighted works; Meta says training is fair use.
reason: Creative-industry legal pushback against AI training.
